description: Body of a character-voice annotation — one character's voice profile.

character_ref.description: The character this voice belongs to — the ``name`` (or id) of a ``character-ref/v1`` annotation. Dialogue speakers are matched against this to resolve which voice speaks a line.
character_ref.title: Character Ref

voice_id.description: The primary TTS voice identifier (provider-specific). The one field a profile must have; ``provider_voice_ids`` carries alternates for other providers.
voice_id.title: Voice Id

provider_voice_ids.description: Per-provider voice ids, keyed by provider slug (``'elevenlabs'``, ``'minimax'``, ...). A synthesis path looks its provider up here first and falls back to ``voice_id`` — which is what lets a production switch providers without recasting every character.
provider_voice_ids.title: Provider Voice Ids

model_id.description: TTS model id (e.g. ``eleven_v3`` for expressive dialogue). None uses the synthesis path's default for the call's register.
model_id.title: Model Id

delivery.description: Name of a delivery preset (e.g. ``V3_NATURAL``) to seed the voice settings; the individual knobs below override it.
delivery.title: Delivery

default_emotion.description: The emotional register this character speaks in unless a line overrides it (``'warm'``, ``'clipped'``, ``'deadpan'`` — free text a synthesis path may map to provider controls or fold into a prompt).
default_emotion.title: Default Emotion

similarity_boost.description: Voice-setting intent (0-1): adherence to the source voice.
similarity_boost.title: Similarity Boost

accent.description: Human-readable accent label. Shown in pickers; a synthesis path MAY fold it into prompt-style controls where the provider has them.
accent.title: Accent

reference_sample_artifact_id.description: Content-addressed id (64-hex lacing ``AssetId``) of a stored voice sample, for cloning providers. An id, not a URL — the sample must survive re-uploads byte-identically.
reference_sample_artifact_id.title: Reference Sample Artifact Id

display_name.description: Human label for this voice in a picker; defaults to the character name.
display_name.title: Display Name

notes.description: Free-form notes about the voice choice (direction, casting rationale).
notes.title: Notes

title: CharacterVoiceBodyV1
